guide.summary: Council linked GPU warnings to thermal pressure during sustained load rather than a failed driver install.
guide.chiefVerdict: Clear intake vents, use a balanced GPU power profile, then re-check Monitor temps after a short game session.

councilDiscussion.content: KB/gpu-thermal-throttling warns against voltage unlocks as a first response.
councilDiscussion.headline: Cool before tune

steps.title: Clear GPU vents
steps.instructions: Power off, clear dust from GPU and case intake vents, then restore airflow before the next gaming session.

steps.title: Recheck Monitor temps
steps.instructions: Open PatchGuard Live Monitor, play for five minutes, and confirm GPU temperature stays below the warning threshold.
